summary: Secure decommission and temporary vaulting of contractor workstation with sealed SSDs for outbound shipment
description:
Issue summary: A contractor workstation (asset tag LTP-9374) is due for decommission ahead of next-week courier pickup. The machine contains two sealed SSDs (SSD-SN-1221, SSD-SN-1222) that must be treated as controlled hardware: chain-of-custody log required, tamper-evident packaging, and temporary storage in locked vault until handoff to the approved carrier.

Impact: If not handled correctly, we risk loss of chain-of-custody, potential data-handling compliance violations, and a missed courier window that delays vendor RMA and onboarding for an incoming hire. This blocks inventory reconciliation for the hardware refresh wave.

Location: SF office, Building 4, Lab B bench 7. Contractor returns access badge tomorrow (2026-03-13) at 09:00 PT.

Requirements and constraints:
- SSDs must remain sealed in anti-static tamper-evident bags.
- Only Facilities and Security staff (Casey, Jordan, and SRE on-call) may open the vault.
- Courier requires a liftgate and arrival window between 11:00–13:00; pickup must be logged in the Chain-of-Custody form and signed by two Redwood staff members.
- Customs paperwork included (shipment outbound to external refurbishment vendor in OR). The shipment needs the vendor's pre-filled proforma and Redwood export authorization code.

Immediate action requested: Secure the workstation, collect chain-of-custody signatures, stage the sealed SSDs in vault V-03, coordinate courier pickup slot, and update inventory record so asset is marked as in-transit for refurbishment.

Notes: Asset sanitization (PSU and NVMe connectors) will be performed on-site by authorized inventory team only after courier confirmation that the SSDs are accepted for refurbishment. No data wipe should be performed until vendor receipt is confirmed to preserve forensic trail.
tasks: Confirm contractor badge return window and collect badge at 09:00 on 2026-03-13
Physically power down and label machine LTP-9374 with decommission sticker
Verify serials for SSDs (SSD-SN-1221, SSD-SN-1222) against asset inventory
Seal SSDs in tamper-evident anti-static bags and photograph packaging (two angles)
Store sealed SSDs in vault V-03; obtain two-staff sign-off on Chain-of-Custody form
Book courier with liftgate and confirm 11:00–13:00 pickup window; upload courier confirmation to ticket
Complete export paperwork and provide vendor proforma to Facilities for handoff
Update inventory system: status -> in-transit (refurbishment), attach photos and CoC PDF
